name: Brass Cassette Cue
description: A brass-heavy cassette cue device used in the community radio studio to trigger music playback during broadcasts. Operated by Noah to introduce music between radio updates.
narrative_significance: Represents the restoration of normalcy and community connection during the emergency broadcast. Noah's operation of the cue to play music signals the transition from crisis-only communications to a more complete service that includes morale-boosting content. The device embodies the station's evolution from bare survival mode to intentional community care.
